qualifying_suppliers.name: CrestLink Forging
qualifying_suppliers.top_finding_text: Dana Kim conducted a follow-up inspection on 2026-06-17. An independent mechanical engineer engaged by the audit team reviewed the pressure-anomaly log for Finding 1 and determined that the documented anomalies exceed the manufacturer's specified tolerance band by up to 23%, creating a credible risk of catastrophic press failure and associated worker-safety exposure. The finding has been escalated: it is now classified as a worker-safety hazard with High severity. The press has not been taken out of service and no verified maintenance has been completed; the finding remains open pending a certified mechanical inspection and sign-off.

qualifying_suppliers.name: ArcLight Cables

The supplier stated the contractor would attend within the week, but no verified completion record has been provided.

qualifying_suppliers.name: OmniFlux Textiles
qualifying_suppliers.top_finding_text: Raj Patel and the buyer's compliance officer conducted a follow-up review on 2026-06-20. During document reconciliation it was discovered that OmniFlux had routed approximately 18% of Q2 embroidery volume through a subcontractor (Hanxi Embroidery Co.) without prior buyer approval, in breach of contract clause 8.2, and had not disclosed this in the original audit response. The estimated value of the unapproved sub-contracted work is USD 115 000, creating a contractual exposure above the USD 50 000 threshold. This is a new finding identified in the re-assessment, classified as a contractual misrepresentation with High severity. No remediation or contractual amendment has been agreed; the finding is open.
